fixtures.question: 上个月总销售额多少
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders WHERE YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

fixtures.question: 各渠道销售额排行
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT channel, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY total_sales DESC

fixtures.question: 手机品类卖得最好的 5 个品牌
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT brand, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_order_details WHERE category = '手机' GROUP BY brand ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5

fixtures.question: 华东区金卡用户买了多少钱
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders WHERE region = '华东' AND customer_tier = '金卡'

fixtures.question: 今年每个月销售额趋势
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT MONTH(date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders WHERE YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

fixtures.question: 哪个支付方式用的人最多
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM wide_orders GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

fixtures.question: 退款率最高的品类是哪些
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT category, SUM(CASE WHEN is_refunded = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS refund_rate FROM wide_order_details GROUP BY category ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 5

fixtures.question: 周末和工作日哪个卖得多
fixtures.baseline_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) IN (1, 7) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM wide_orders GROUP BY day_type
